iter 1: parallel residuals (no inner) + deq_beta 0.20 + SWA OFF + EMA OFF + 1h. Post-int6: 1.6209 (vs iter 0's 2.4074, -0.787 BPB win confirms SWA/EMA were the killer). K-sweep k4=k8=k16=1.6209 perfect fixed-point invariance. Artifact 8.87MB. Still +0.21 above old broken baseline 1.4094 — gap is undertraining (831 steps in 1h) vs old broken baseline (3058 steps in 20min). iter 2: + gg_gate.bias init=1.5 (force more iterative depth). Model REJECTED the init: gg_mean dropped 0.82 (init) -> 0.11 (step 200) -> 0.23 (step 832), nearly identical trajectory to iter 1. Final val_bpb 1.62035 vs iter 1's 1.62090 (delta 0.0006 = noise). K-sweep k4=k8=k16=1.6203 (still flat). Initialization-only interventions cannot override optimizer preference for shallow DEQ. Pivot to iter 3 = double experts (add capacity in the regime model likes)

Retry with stronger balance loss
